unit.reading: qui est bis millesimus et quingentesimus annus a creatura orbis terrae
nam secus qui in oriente sunt numerus ... mus et .. mus et .... mus profectionis fynicis
cum exiuit plebs post profectionem quae fiebat per mosysen usque amman trans iordanem
profetiae quae facta est a moysen in libro deuteronomio
qui uocauit ad se iesum filium naue hominem probatum domino
ut sit successor plebi et scene testimonii cum omnibus sanctis illius
ut et inducat plebem in terram datam extribus eorum
ut detur illis per testamentum et per iusiurandum quod locutus est in scenae dare de iesum dicendo ad iesum uerbum hoc
et promitte secus industriam tuam omnia quae mandata sunt ut facias quemadmodum sine quaerellam est
ideo haec dicit dominus orbis terrarum
Creauit enim orbem terrarum propter plebem suam
et non coepit eam inceptionem creaturae et ab initio orbis terrarum palam facere ut in eam gentes arguantur et humiliter inter se disputationibus arguant se
itaque excogitauit et inuenit me qui ab initio orbis terrarum praeparatus sum ut sim arbiter testamenti illius
et tunc palam facio tibi quia consummatum est tempus annorum uitae meae et transio in dormitionem patrum meorum et palam omnem plebem
autem percipe scribturam hanc ad recognoscendam tutationem librorum quos tibi tradam
quos ordinabis et chedriabis et reponis in uasis fictilibus in loco quem fecit ab initio creaturae orbis terrarum
ut inuocetur nomen illius usque in diem paenitentiae in respectu quo respicit illos dominus in consummatione exitus dierum
intrabunt per te in terram quam decreuit et promisit dare patribus eorum
in qua tu benedicis et dabis unicuique et stabilibis eis sortem in me et constabilibis eis regnum et magisteria locorum dimittes illis secus quod placebit domino eorum in iudicio et iustitia

autem postquam intrabunt in terram suam annos et postea dominabitur a principibus et tyrannis per annos xuiii et xuiiii annos abrumpens tib x nam descendent tribus duae et transferunt scenae testimonium
tunc deus caelestis fecit palam scenae suae et ferrum sanctuarii sui et ponentur duae tribus sanctitatis
nam x tribus stabilient sibi secus ordinationes suas regna
et adferent uictimas per annos xx
et uii circumuallabunt muros Et circumibo uiiii et adcedent ad testamentum domini et finem polluent quem fecit dominus cum eis
et immolabunt natos suos diis alienis et ponent idola scenae seruientes illis
et in domo domini facient sceleste et sculpent omnem animalium idola multa
illis temporibus ueniet illis ab oriente rex et teget equitatus terram eorum et
incendet colonia eorum igne cum aede sancta domini et sancta uasa omnia tollet
et omnem plebem eiciet et ducet illos in terram patriae suae et duas tribus ducit secum
Tunc inuocabunt duae tribus x tribus et ducent se ut liena in campis puluerati esurientes et sitientes cum infantibus nostris
et clamabunt iustus et sanctus dominus quia enim uos peccastis et nos pariter adducti sumus uobiscum
tunc plorabunt x tribus audientes inproperia uerborum tribum duarum
et dicent quid faciemus uobis fratres nonne in omnem domum istrahel aduenit clibsis haec
et omnes tribus plorabunt clamantes in caelum et dicentes
deus abraham et deus isaac et deus iacob reminiscere testamentum tuum quod factasti cum eis et iusiurandum quod iurasti eis per te ne umquam deficiat semen eorum a terra quam dedisti illis
Tunc reminiscentur me die illo dicentes tribus ad tribum et homo de proximo suo
nonne hoc est quod testabatur nobis cum moyses in profetis qui multa passus est in aegypto et in mari rubro et in heremo annis xl
testatus et inuocabat nobis testes caelum et terram ne praeteriremus mandata illius in quibus arbiter fuit nobis
quae aduenerunt nobis de isto secus uerba ipsius et secus adfirmationem ipsius quomodo testatus est nobis temporibus illis et quae conuenerunt usque nos duci captiuos in partem orientis
qui et seruient circa annos lxxvii
Tunc intrauit unus qui supra eos est et expandit manus et ponit genua sua et orauit pro eis dicens
Domine omnis rex in alta sede qui dominaris saeculo qui uoluisti plebem hanc esse tibi plebem hanc exceptam tunc uoluisti inuocari eorum deus secus testamentum quod fecisti cum patribus eorum
et ierunt captiui in terram alienam cum uxoribus et natis suis et circa ostium allofilorum et ubi est maiestas magna
respice et miserere eorum domine caelestis
Tunc reminiscitur deus eorum propter testamentum quod fecit cum patribus illorum et palam faciet misericordiam suam et temporibus illis
et mittit in animam regis ut misereator eorum et dimittit illos in terram eorum et regionem
tunc ascendent aliquae partes tribuum et uenient in locum constitutum suum et circumuallabunt locum renouantes
duae autem tribus permanebunt in praeposita fide sua tristes et gementes quia non poterint referre immolationes domino patruum suorum
et x tribus crescent et deuenient apud natos in tempore tribum
et cum adpropiabunt tempora arguendi et uindicta surgit de reges participes scelerum
et punientes eos et ipsi diuidentur ad ueritatem propter quod factum fuit
deuitabunt iustitiam et accedent ad iniquitatem et contaminabunt in genationibus domum seruitutis suae et quia fornicabunt post deos alienos
non enim sequentur ueritatem dei sed quidam altarium inquinabunt de muneribus quae inponent domino qui non sunt sacerdotes sed serui de seruis nati
qui enim magistri sunt doctores eorum illis temporibus erunt mirantes personas cupiditatum et acceptiones munerum et peruendent iustitias accipiendo poenas

et ideo implebitur colonia et fines habitationis eorum sceleribus et iniquitatibus a deo ut qui facit erunt impii iudices erunt in eam post fines habitationis sceleribus et iniquitatibus a domino qui faciunt erunt impii iudices inerunt in campo iudicare quomodo quisquae uolet
tunc exurgent illis reges imperantes et in sacerdotes summi dei uocabuntur facient facientes impietatem ab sancto sanctitatis
et succedit illis rex petulans qui non erit de genere sacerdotum homo temerarius et improbus et iudicabit illis quomodo digni erunt
qui elidit principales eorum gladio et locis ignotis singuli et corpora illorum ut nemo sciat ubi sint corpora illorum
occidit maiores natu et iuuenes et non parcet
tunc timor erit illius aceruus in eis in terram eorum
et faciet in eis iudicia quomodo fecerunt in illis aegypti per xxx et iiii annos et puniunt eos
et .. rodincit natos ... ecedentes sibi breuiora tempora donarent
in pares eorum mortis uenient et occidentes rex potens quia expugnabit eos
et ducent captiuos et partem aedis ipsorum igni incendit aliquos crucifigit circa coloniam eorum
ex quo facto finientur tempora momento .... etur cursus a .... horae iiii ueniant
coguntur secun ..... ae .... pos .... initiis tribus ad exitus viiii propter initium tres septimae secunda tria in tertia duae h .. ra .. tae
et regnarunt de his homines pestilentiosi et impii docentes se esse iustos
et hi suscitabunt iram animorum suorum qui erunt homines dolosi sibi placentes ficti in omnibus suis et omni hora diei amantes conuiuia deuoratores gulae
..... rum bonorum comestores dicentes se haec facere propter misericordiam qu ...
se et exterminatores quaeru ... fallaces celantes se ne possent cognosci impii in scelere pleni et iniquitate ab oriente usque ad occidentem
dicentes habebimus discubitiones et luxuriam edentes et bibentes Et putauimus nos tamquam principes erimus
et manus eorum et mentes inmunda tractantes et os eorum loquetur ingentia et super dicent
noli .... tange ne inquines me loco in quo ... s ...... is d ........ su ..... us ..... in ......... re .... raui .... in plebem quae s .. a .. illis

et .. ta .. ueniet in eos ultio et ira quae talis non fuit in illis a saeculo usque ad illum tempus in quo suscitauit illis regem regum terrae et potestatem a potentia magna qui confitentes circumcisionem in cruce suspendit
Nam necantes torquebit et tradidit duci uinctos in custodiam
et uxores eorum diis donabuntur gentibus Et filii eorum pueri secabantur a medicis pueri inducere acrosisam illis
nam illi in eis punientur in tormentis et igne et ferro et cogentur palam baiulare idola eorum inquinata quomodo sunt pariter continentibus ea
et a torquentibus illos pariter cogentur intrare in abditum locum eorum et cogentur stimulis blasfemare uerbum contumeliose nouissime post haec et leges quod haberent supra altarium suum
tunc illo dicente hom de tribu leuui cuius nomen erit taxo qui habens vii filios dicens ad eos rogans
uidete filii ecce ultio facta est in plebe altera crudelis inmunda et traductio sine misericordia et eminent principatum
quae enim gens aut quae regio aut quis populus impiorum in domum qui multa scelesta fecerunt tanta mala passi sunt quanta nobis contegerunt
Nunc ergo filii audite me uidete enim et scite quia numquam temptans deum nec parentes nec proaui eorum ut praetereant mandata illius
scitis enim quia haec sunt uires nobis et hoc faciemus
ieiunemus triduo et quarto die intremus in spelunca quae in agro est et moriamur potius quam praetereamus mandata domini dominorum dei parentum nostrorum
hoc enim si faciemus et moriemur sanguis noster uindicauitur coram domino
Et tunc parebit regnum illius in omni creatura illius Et tunc zabulus finem habebit et tristitiam cum eo adducetur
Tunc implebuntur manus nuntii qui est in summo constitutus qui protinus uindicauit illos ab inimicis eorum
.....get enim caelestis a sede regni sui et exiet de habitatione sancta sua cum indignationem et iram propter filios suos
et tremebit terra usque ad fines suas concutietur et alti montes humiliabuntur et concutientur et conualles cadent
sol non dabit lumen et in tenebris conuertent se cornua lunae et confringentur et tota conuertit se in sanguine et orbis stellarum conturuauitur
et mare usque ad abyssum decedit ad fontes aquarum deficient et flumina expauescent
quia exurgit summus deus aeternus solus et palam ueniet ut uindicet gentes et perdet omnia idola eorum
Tunc felix eris tu istrahel et ascendes supra ceruices et alas aquilae et inplebuntur
et altauit te deus et faciet te herere caelo stellarum loco habitationis eorum
et conspiges a summo et uides inimicos tuos in terram et cognosces illos et gaudebis et agis gratias et confiteberis creatori tuo
nam tu iesu naue custodi uerba haec et hunc librum
erunt enim a morte receptionem usque ad aduentum illius tempora ccl quae fiunt

Ego autem ad dormitionem patrum meorum eram

et hortatus est cum monse et plorauit cum eo
Et respondit illi et dixit iesus
quid me celares domine monse et quo genere celabor de qua locutus est uoce acerua que exiuit de ore tuo quae est plena lacrimis et gemitibus quia tu discedis de plebe ist ......
quis locus recipit .... te
aut quod erit monumentum sepulturae
aut quis audeuit corpus tuum transferre in eut homo de loco in locum

Omnibus enim morientibus secus aetatem sepulturae suae sunt in terris nam tua sepultura ab oriente sole usque ad occidentem et ab austro usque ad fines aquilonis omnis orbis terrarum sepulcrum est tuum
domine abhis Et quis nutrit plebem istam
aut quis est qui miserebitur illis et quis eis dux erit in uia
aut quis orabit pro eis nec patiens ne uno quidem diem ut inducam illos in terram araborum

quomodo ergo potero plebem hanc tamquam pater unicum filium aut tamquam filiam dominam uirginem quae paratur tali uiro quae timebat corpus custodiens eius a sole et ne scalciati pedes eius ad currendum supra terram
..... de uoluntatem eorum praestabo illis ciborum et potui secus uoluntatem uoluntatis eorum

sed et reges amorreorum cum audierint expugnare nos credentes iam non esse semet sacrum spiritum dignum domino multiplicem et inconpraehensibilem dominum uerbi fidelem in omnia diuinum per orbem terrarum profetem consummatum in saeculo doctorem iam non esse in eis dicens Eamus ad eos

si inimici impie fecerunt semel adhuc in dominum suum non est defensor illis qui ferat pro eis praeces domino quomodo monse erat magnus nuntius qui singulis horis diebus et noctibus habebat genua sua infixa in terra orans et intuens hominipotentem orbem terrarum cum misericordia et iustitia reminiscens testamentum parentum et iureiurando placando dominum

quod ergo fiet plebi isti domine monse

Et monse prendit manum ipsius et erexit illum in cathedra ante se Et respondit et dixit illi
iesus et ne contemnas sed praebe te securum et adtende uerbis meis

omnes gentes quae sunt in ore terrarum deus creauit et nos praeuidit illos et nos ab initio creaturae orbis terrarum ut ad exitum saeculi Et nihil est ab eo neglectum usque ad pusillum sed omnia praeuidit et prououit cum eis ..
dns omnia quae futura essent in hoc orbe terrarum prouidit et ecce aufertur
......... s me constituit pro eis et pro peccatis eorum .. .... et in .. ccare .. pro eis

exiuit enim deus qui praeuidit omnia in saecula et stabilitum est testamentum illius et iureiu ando quod

unit.reading: which is the two thousand five hundredth year from the creation of the earth.
For otherwise, the number of those in the east ... and ... and ... of the departure of the Phoenix
when the people went out after the departure that was made by Moses up to Amman across the Jordan,
of the prophecy that was made by Moses in the book of Deuteronomy.
who called to himself Jesus, son of Nun, a man approved by the Lord,
to be a successor to the people and to the tabernacle of testimony with all its holy things,
so that he might lead the people into the land given to their tribes,
so that it might be given to them by covenant and by oath, which he spoke in the tabernacle, to give concerning Jesus, saying this word to Jesus:
“And promise according to your diligence to do all that has been commanded, as it is without dispute.
Therefore, thus says the Lord of the world:
For he created the world for the sake of his people.

And he did not begin its inception of creation and from the beginning of the world make it manifest, so that the Gentiles might be convicted concerning it and humbly dispute among themselves and convict themselves.
Therefore, he devised and found me, who from the beginning of the world was prepared to be the arbiter of his covenant.
And then I make it clear to you that the time of the years of my life is fulfilled, and I pass into the sleep of my fathers and openly to all the people.
However, receive this writing to recognize the safekeeping of the books which I will deliver to you,
which you shall arrange and bind and place in earthenware vessels in the place which he made from the beginning of the creation of the world,
so that his name may be invoked until the day of repentance, in the regard with which the Lord looks upon them at the consummation of the end of days.”
Through you they will enter into the land which he decreed and promised to give to their fathers,

in which you will bless and give to each one and establish for them a lot in me, and you will confirm for them a kingdom, and you will leave to them the offices of the places according to what will please their Lord in judgment and righteousness.

However, after they enter into their land, for years, and afterwards it will be ruled by princes and tyrants for eighteen years, and for eighteen years, breaking off from the tribe of x, for two tribes will descend and transfer the tabernacle of testimony.
Then the God of heaven made manifest his tabernacle and the iron of his sanctuary, and two tribes of holiness will be established.
For ten tribes will establish kingdoms for themselves according to their ordinances,
and they will offer sacrifices for twenty years.
And seven will surround the walls, and I will go around nine, and they will approach the covenant of the Lord and will pollute the boundary which the Lord made with them.
And they will sacrifice their sons to foreign gods, and they will place idols in the tabernacle, serving them.
And in the house of the Lord they will act wickedly and will carve many idols of every animal.
In those times, a king will come to them from the east, and his cavalry will cover their land and
he will set fire to their colony with the holy house of the Lord, and he will take all the holy vessels.
And he will cast out all the people and will lead them into the land of his own country, and he will lead two tribes with him.
Then the two tribes will call out to the ten tribes, and they will lead themselves like lions in the dusty fields, hungry and thirsty with our children.
And they will cry out, “Righteous and holy is the Lord! For you have sinned, and we likewise have been brought with you.”
Then the ten tribes will weep, hearing the reproaches of the words of the two tribes,
and they will say, “What shall we do to you, brothers? Has not this affliction come upon every house of Israel?”
And all the tribes will weep, crying out to heaven and saying,

O God of Abraham, and God of Isaac, and God of Jacob, remember your covenant which you made with them and the oath which you swore to them by yourself, that their seed would never fail from the land which you gave to them.
Then they will remember me on that day, saying, tribe to tribe and a man to his neighbor,
“Is this not what Moses testified to us among the prophets, who suffered many things in Egypt and in the Red Sea and in the wilderness for forty years?
He testified and called heaven and earth as witnesses for us, lest we transgress his commandments in which he was our arbiter.

These things have come upon us according to his words and according to his affirmation, just as he testified to us in those times, and which have come upon us, even to be led captive to the eastern region.
And they will serve for about seventy-seven years.”
Then one who is over them entered and spread out his hands and knelt down and prayed for them, saying,

“Lord, the king of all on high, who rules the world, who willed this people to be your people, this chosen people, then you willed to be called their God, according to the covenant which you made with their fathers.
And they went captive to a foreign land with their wives and children, and near the gate of foreigners and where great majesty is.
Look and have mercy on them, O heavenly Lord.”
Then their God remembers because of the covenant which he made with their fathers, and he will make known his mercy even in those times.
And he sends into the heart of the king that he might have mercy on them and dismiss them to their land and region.
Then some parts of the tribes will ascend and come to their appointed place and will surround the place, renewing it.
But two tribes will remain steadfast in their appointed faith, sorrowful and groaning, because they will not be able to offer sacrifices to the Lord, the God of their fathers.
And the ten tribes will grow and will come among the children in the time of the tribe.
And when the times of rebuke draw near and vengeance arises from kings, sharers in wickedness,
and punishing them, and they themselves will be divided against the truth because of what happened.
They will avoid justice and approach iniquity, and they will defile the house of their servitude through generations, and because they will commit fornication after foreign gods.
For they will not follow the truth of God, but some will defile the altars with the offerings which they will impose on the Lord, who are not priests but servants born of servants.
For those who are their masters and teachers in those times will be admiring persons of greed and receivers of gifts, and they will sell justice, receiving penalties.

And therefore the settlement and the limits of their habitation will be filled with wickedness and iniquities from God, so that those who act will be impious judges; they will be within it after the limits of the habitation with wickedness and iniquities from the Lord. Those who act will be impious judges; they will be in the field to judge as each one wishes.
Then kings ruling over them will arise, and they will be called high priests of God, performing impiety from the holy of holies.
And a petulant king will succeed them, who will not be of the lineage of priests, a rash and wicked man, and he will judge them as they deserve.
He will strike down their leaders with the sword, and each one in unknown places, and their bodies, so that no one knows where their bodies are.
He kills the elders and the young, and he will not spare.
Then his great terror will be upon them in their land.
And he will execute judgments upon them as the Egyptians did to them for thirty-four years, and they will punish them.
And he will subdue the children, yielding shorter times to themselves.
They will come to their peers in death, and a powerful king will kill them because he will conquer them.
And they will lead captives, and he burns a part of their temple with fire; some he crucifies around their settlement.
From this deed, the times will end in a moment. The course will be completed in four hours.
They are compelled according to the beginnings, three to the ends, nine because of the beginning, three, the seventh, the second, three, in the third, two hours.
And pestilential and impious men will reign from these, teaching themselves to be righteous.
And these will stir up the anger of their souls, who will be deceitful men, self-pleasing, feigned in all their ways, and at every hour of the day loving feasts, devourers of gluttony.
They will despise all divine things.
... eaters of good things, saying that they do these things out of mercy...
themselves and destroyers seeking... deceivers concealing themselves so that they could not be known, impious, full of crime and iniquity from east to west.
saying, 'We will have banquets and luxury, eating and drinking.' And we thought, 'We will be like princes.'
And their hands and minds handle impure things, and their mouth will speak great things, and they will moreover say,
'Do not... touch, lest you defile me, in the place where... s... is d... su... us... in... re... raui... to the people who are to them.'

And then vengeance and wrath will come upon them, such as has not been upon them from the beginning until that time, in which he raised up for them a king of the kings of the earth and a power from great power, who will crucify those confessing circumcision.
For he will torture those who kill, and he delivered the bound to the leader into custody.
And their wives will be given to the gods of the nations. And their children, male infants, will be circumcised by doctors, male infants to induce acrosis on them.
For they will be punished in them with torments and fire and iron, and will be forced to openly carry their defiled idols, just as they are equally holding them.

And by those tormenting them, they will likewise be forced to enter their hidden place, and will be forced by goads to blaspheme the word contemptuously, and finally after these things, even the laws that they had above their altar.
Then, as he spoke, a man from the tribe of Levi, whose name will be Taxo, who had seven sons, speaking to them, imploring,
'See, sons, behold, vengeance has come upon another people, cruel, impure, and a degradation without mercy, and they hold prominence.'
For what nation, or what region, or what people of the impious in a house who committed many wicked deeds have suffered such evils as have befallen us?
Now therefore, sons, listen to me, for you see and know that neither their parents nor their ancestors ever tempted God to transgress his commandments.
For you know that these are our strengths, and we will do this.
Let us fast for three days, and on the fourth day let us enter the cave that is in the field, and let us die rather than transgress the commandments of the Lord of lords, the God of our parents.
For if we do this and die, our blood will be avenged before the Lord.
And then his kingdom will appear in all his creation. And then the devil will have an end, and sorrow will be brought with him.
Then the hands of the messenger who is appointed on high will be filled, who will immediately avenge them from their enemies.
For the Heavenly One will... from the throne of his kingdom, and will go forth from his holy dwelling with indignation and wrath because of his sons.
And the earth will tremble to its ends, it will be shaken, and the high mountains will be humbled and shaken, and the valleys will fall.
The sun will not give light, and the horns of the moon will turn into darkness and will be broken, and the whole will turn into blood, and the sphere of the stars will be disturbed.
And the sea will recede to the abyss, the sources of the waters will fail, and the rivers will be terrified.
Because the Most High God, the Eternal One alone, arises, and will come openly to avenge the nations and destroy all their idols.
Then you, O Israel, will be blessed, and you will ascend upon the necks and wings of the eagle, and you will be filled.
And God will exalt you and make you inherit the heaven of stars, the place of their dwelling.
And you will look down from on high and see your enemies on the earth, and you will recognize them, and you will rejoice and give thanks and confess your Creator.
For you, Joshua son of Nun, keep these words and this book.
For there will be 250 times from death's reception until his coming, which are accomplished.
And this course... of these which they meet until they are consumed.
But I was going to the sleep of my fathers.
Therefore, you, Joshua son of Nun, God has chosen you to be my successor of the same covenant.
And when Joshua heard the words of Moses, all that were written in his scripture, all that he had foretold, he tore his garments and fell at my feet.
And he encouraged Moses and wept with him.
And Joshua answered him and said,

“Why do you conceal me, Lord Moses? And in what way shall I be concealed? Concerning what did that harsh voice speak, which came out of your mouth, which is full of tears and groans, because you are departing from this people….”
“What place receives you…?”
“Or what will be the monument of burial?”
“Or who would dare to transfer your body, O man, from place to place?”

“For all who die according to their age have their burial places on the earth. But your burial, from the rising of the sun to its setting, and from the south to the ends of the north, the whole orb of the earth is your sepulchre.”
“Lord, Ah! And who will nourish this people?”
“Or who is it who will pity them? And who will be their leader on the way?”
“Or who will pray for them, not even enduring for a single day, so that I might lead them into the land of the Arabs?”

“How then shall I be able to [care for] this people, like a father his only son, or like a master a virgin daughter who is prepared for such a husband, who guarded her body, fearing the sun, and lest her feet be unshod for running upon the earth?”
“... I will provide for them food and drink according to their desire, according to their will.”
“... for there were a hundred thousand of them. But these have grown so much through your prayers, Lord Moses.”
“And what wisdom or understanding do I have in the house… to speak words or to judge or to answer?”

“But also the kings of the Amorites, when they hear, will believe that we have been overcome, saying, ‘There is no longer a sacred spirit worthy of the Lord among them, a multiple and incomprehensible Lord of the word, faithful in all things, a divine prophet perfected throughout the world, a teacher. Let us go to them!’”

“If the enemies have sinned impiously, once again, against their Lord, there is no defender for them who would offer prayers for them to the Lord, as Moses was a great messenger who, at every hour, day and night, had his knees fixed on the ground, praying and beholding the omnipotent world with mercy and justice, remembering the covenant of the parents and placating the Lord by an oath.”
“For they will say, ‘He is not with them. Therefore, let us go and confound them from the face of the earth.’”
“What then will become of this people, Lord Moses?”
And after Jesus finished his words, he again prostrated himself at Moses’ feet.
And Moses took his hand and raised him up to a chair before him. And he answered and said to him,
“Joshua, do not be contemptuous, but show yourself secure and attend to my words.”

“All the nations that are on the face of the earth, God created, and He foreknew them and us from the beginning of the creation of the world until the end of the age. And nothing is neglected by Him, not even the smallest thing, but He foreknew and prepared all things with them….”
“The Lord foreknew all things that would happen in this world, and behold, he is taken away.”
“……he appointed me for them, and for their sins…. and to… for them.”
“For not because of my strength or weakness, but rather His mercy and patience have covered me.”
“For I say to you, Joshua, not because of the piety of this people will you exterminate the nations.”
“All the firmaments of the heavens and the world were made as tried by God, and they are under none other than His right hand.”
“Therefore, those who do and fulfill the commandments of God grow and demand a good way.”
“But those who sin and neglect the commandments are deprived of the good things that were foretold. And they will be punished by the nations with many torments.”
“For it is impossible that he should completely exterminate and abandon them.”
“For God, who foreknew all things forever, has gone forth, and His covenant and His oath, which…”
